# External Tools

Place manually downloaded external tools here.

Expected layout:

```text
external/
  PCSX2-MCP/
    pcsx2-qt.exe
    pcsx2-mcp-server/
  ps2-recomp-Agent-SKILL/
    SKILL.md
    resources/
```

These folders are intentionally not required for the recomp runner itself. They are used by the live PCSX2-MCP trace workflow.
